description.narrative: The project involves the construction, operation and maintenance of a 15-megawatt (MW) solar power plant in Khushig valley, Tuv aimag, which is located 40 kilometers (km) from Mongolia's capital, Ulaanbaatar, and 17 km from the new international airport. It will also entail the construction of a 110/10kV substation, a 14-km long 110kV double circuit overhead electricity transmission line, as well as the extension of the 110/10kV Khushig substation owned by the National Power Transmission Grid SOJSC.
